classification.difficultyReason: Name twelve highlighted circle features, including major and minor regions.

content.prompt: Name the highlighted parts of the circle.

spec.description: Circle with a highlighted chord joining lower-left and right circumference points.
spec.mathematics: Both chord endpoints lie on the circumference; the chord does not pass through the centre.

answer.worked: chord — a line segment joining two points on the circumference.

spec.description: The larger region below an oblique chord is highlighted.
spec.mathematics: A major segment bounded by a chord and the major arc.

answer.worked: segment — the highlighted major segment is bounded by a chord and an arc.

spec.description: Right half of the circle highlighted, with a vertical diameter and centre point.
spec.mathematics: The diameter divides the circle into two semicircles.

answer.worked: semicircle — half a circle bounded by a diameter and an arc.

spec.description: Circle with only its centre point highlighted.
spec.mathematics: The highlighted point is equidistant from every point on the circumference.

answer.worked: centre — the point equally distant from all points on the circumference.

spec.description: Highlighted lower-left to upper-right diameter through the centre.
spec.mathematics: The straight segment joins opposite circumference points through the centre.

answer.worked: diameter — a chord passing through the centre.

spec.mathematics: The highlighted curve is the entire circle boundary.

answer.worked: circumference — the complete boundary of the circle.

spec.description: Highlighted sector on the right between upper-left and lower-right radii.
spec.mathematics: The minor sector is bounded by two radii and their connecting arc.

answer.worked: sector — the highlighted minor sector is bounded by two radii and an arc.

spec.description: Highlighted horizontal radius extending rightwards from the centre.
spec.mathematics: The segment joins the centre to the circumference.

answer.worked: radius — a line segment from the centre to the circumference.

spec.description: The small upper-left region above an oblique chord is highlighted.
spec.mathematics: A minor segment bounded by a chord and the minor arc.

answer.worked: segment — the highlighted minor segment is bounded by a chord and an arc.

spec.description: Highlighted line below the circle rising slightly to the right and touching the circle once.
spec.mathematics: The line is perpendicular to the radius at its contact point, so it is exactly tangent.
spec.answerVisibility: No answer label or added right-angle mark.

answer.worked: tangent — a straight line touching the circumference at one point.

spec.description: Only an upper portion of the circumference is highlighted.
spec.mathematics: The highlighted curve is an arc, a portion of the circumference.

spec.description: The major sector is highlighted; a small downward-pointing sector remains white.
spec.mathematics: Two radii and the major arc bound the highlighted major sector.

answer.worked: sector — the highlighted major sector is bounded by two radii and the major arc.
